why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: Add Robinhood Chain Testnet to your wallet. The docs give chain ID 46630, ETH as the currency and https://rpc.testnet.chain.robinhood.com as the RPC address.
Get testnet ETH for gas from the Robinhood faucet linked inside the app.
Open note.systems/app and connect a wallet. The docs list MetaMask, Rabby, Coinbase Wallet, Phantom and the Robinhood Wallet browser.

Use the faucet in the app to claim mock USDG and mock stock tokens. It gives 1,000 USDG and 10 shares per address every 24 hours. Warning Everything on the testnet is mock money. Don't send real USDG or real stock tokens, and treat any site asking for them as fake until the note contracts launch on mainnet.
Pick a stock series that is open for deposits, choose a barrier and deposit your mock funds.
Open the community page and sign in with the same wallet to see your points, streak and rank. Signing in is a message signature and costs no gas.
Keep notes alive across observation dates to build a streak, and watch @notesystems for the mainnet terms.
